description: Kendall-readout, SOFT signs (quality-ceiling test). Same as exp551 (residual->E=64, tied head, K=384 pairs) but logit uses SOFT rank f(d)=d/(T+|d|) instead of hard sign -> continuous rank-similarity, richer per-comparison signal (real low-rank matmul, NOT matmul-free). Measures how much the 1-bit popcount (exp551 ~+0.24 plateau) costs. If soft reaches ~Linear, the rank idea is validated and we pursue multi-bit codes. vs exp551 hard (~+0.24), exp513 Linear 1.4825/1.4656.
